items.title: 大华ICC命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程未认证攻击者向大华ICC发送特制请求，可注入系统命令并执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复版本，限制ICC管理面暴露
items.repro_note: 未认证向ICC接口发送特制请求，构造命令注入参数；需目标可达
items.impact_scope: 视频监控管理平台，常暴露内网
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in the Dahua Intelligent Connection Center. A remote attacker could send a specially crafted request to the affected system, allowing the attacker to execute arbitrary commands, resulting in remote code execution.

items.title: Vvveb密码重置认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者伪造user和token参数调用密码重置，可接管任意账户
items.action_zh: 升级至1.0.8.7并核查异常密码重置
items.repro_note: 未授权访问密码重置接口，构造user/token GET参数绕过校验
items.impact_scope: CMS网站后台，可能暴露公网
items.description: Vvveb is a powerful and easy to use CMS with page builder to build websites, blogs or ecommerce stores. Prior to version 1.0.8.7, the password reset functionality is vulnerable to an Authentication Bypass due to insufficient validation of the user and token GET parameters. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.8.7.

items.title: 报告写入组件路径遍历
items.title_zh: 报告写入组件路径遍历
items.summary_zh: 能提交报告任务者控制报告文件名，将JSON写出目录并覆盖主机文件，可破坏应用运行
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 应用修复，校验报告文件名并限制目录权限
items.repro_note: 构造含../的报告文件名并提交JSON，观察报告目录外写入
items.impact_scope: 报告生成服务，主机文件可被覆盖
items.description: A traversal filename therefore writes the supplied JSON outside the intended report directory. This permits host-file overwrite subject to the accepted JSON-content constraint and can disrupt application operation; the demonstrated primitive does not establish unrestricted executable contents or unconditional cross-tenant confidentiality loss.

items.title: SOC平台存储型XSS
items.summary_zh: 低权限用户污染告警或案例字段，其他用户查看时执行脚本，可劫持会话
items.action_zh: 升级修复，对SOC字段输出编码并启用CSP
items.repro_note: 在告警/案例字段注入脚本，诱使其他用户查看对应详情页
items.impact_scope: SOC运营平台，可劫持分析师会话
items.description: When another user views the poisoned alert, stored script executes on the application origin; the same unsanitized rendering pattern affects server-stored SOC case, asset and health-check fields in `SocCaseNote.vue`, `SocCaseItem.vue`, `SocCaseAssetsItem.vue`, `SocAlertAssetsItem.vue` and `HealthcheckItem.vue`. An injected script can steal both tokens, impersonate the viewer and obtain fresh tokens through `/auth/refresh`.

items.title: OpenDeepWiki硬编码JWT密钥
items.summary_zh: 未认证者用公开Jwt:SecretKey伪造Admin令牌，控制用户、角色、仓库与API密钥
items.action_zh: 升级修复，更换JWT密钥并轮换API密钥
items.impact_scope: 知识库管理后台，可完全接管
items.description: OpenDeepWiki through 2.0.6 contains a hard-coded JWT signing key vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens using the publicly known Jwt:SecretKey in appsettings.json. Attackers can mint HS256 bearer tokens with an Admin role claim to access /api/admin endpoints and control users, roles, repositories, settings, and API keys.

items.title: MuseBot默认会话密钥绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证者用硬编码session_key伪造管理员Cookie，读取敏感数据并停用机器人
items.action_zh: 升级至2.0.0，更换session_key并清理会话
items.impact_scope: 机器人管理后台，可读配置与聊天记录
items.description: MuseBot before 2.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge admin sessions by using the hard-coded default session_key 'muse_bot_session_key'. Attackers can sign a MuseBot-session cookie carrying a user_id to gain full administrative access, reading password hashes, chat records, and bot configuration, and stopping bots.

items.title: ng-antd-admin认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可绕过认证授权，冒充任意用户含管理员，访问受保护API并接管账户
items.action_zh: 升级修复，更换JWT密钥并审计受保护接口
items.repro_note: 伪造或篡改认证令牌访问受保护API，验证用户与管理员越权
items.impact_scope: 后台管理模板，可能导致账户接管
items.description: ng-antd-admin is an Angular and NestJS administration system template. An attacker can bypass authentication and authorization, impersonate any user including administrators, and access protected API endpoints, leading to account takeover, data leakage and unauthorized operations.
